title: Google says it will begin removing Google Assistant from Android and Wear OS devices on September 4, replaced by Gemini; Assistant remains on connected cars (Abner Li/9to5Google)
summary: Abner Li / 9to5Google: Google says it will begin removing Google Assistant from Android and Wear OS devices on September 4, replaced by Gemini; Assistant remains on connected cars — As expected, Google Assistant is going away in 2026, and the company just provided a September 4 date for Android.
